cohort: Calcification Test Cohort (N=236 images across all 4 sites)
scientific_interpretation: Hypothesis rejected (Null Result): High-resolution patch expert fusion on weak labels does not provide statistically significant lift over the global ResNet-18 model (Delta AUC < +0.030 or CI crosses zero). Per Decision D-010 and AGENTS.md Rule 5, the detector is retained strictly as an explainability and reporting tool.
